title: Print a task card
prompt: Print two lines, exactly: Card: Pack boxes, then Status: waiting.
hints: Put each line's text in double quotes inside Console.WriteLine( ).
Check the capital letters: Card, Pack and Status start with a capital. boxes and waiting do not.
checkLabels: The output must be Card: Pack boxes, then Status: waiting, on two lines.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Prints the status before the card.
Changes a capital letter in the required text.

feedback: Compare each printed line with the prompt. The order of the lines and every capital letter must match.
